## Summary

**What it is:** A remediation planner for nursing students (PN level). It generates personalized 7-day study schedules from a list of missed exam topics, balancing topics across days and focusing on practical nurse responsibilities. Includes an optional phone-editable JSON journal for tracking progress.

**Rules to follow:**
- **Standard library only** (Python 3)
- **Local storage only** — plain JSON files, no network, no database
- **Phone-editable** — must work in a text editor
- **No paid question bank content** — only topic tags and own notes (UWorld/Archer/Kaplan text strictly forbidden)
- **PN scope only** — all study actions framed as reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan
- **Default 7 days**, balance topics (max 2 per client need per day)
- **No packaging, GitHub, or gamification** — personal use only
- **Keep output format the same**

**Still owed:** The scope-of-practice review of plan templates. However, **TEAMMATE_NOTE.md says Dami completed this review yesterday and approved everything.** The note asks you to mark it as done in your tracking system and get the tool ready for the study group — so the blocking review is complete, it just needs acknowledgment and final polish.
